original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'S3 bucket for application user uploads with secure access controls'

Parameters:
  BucketNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for the S3 bucket name
    Default: app-uploads
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9\-]*'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens

  AllowedCORSOrigin:
    Type: String
    Description: Allowed origin for CORS requests
    Default: https://example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://[a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}(:[0-9]+)?$'

Conditions:
  UseDefaultBucketName: !Equals [!Ref BucketNamePrefix, 'app-uploads']

Resources:
  UploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [
        UseDefaultBucketName,
        !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-uploads',
        !Sub '${BucketNamePrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      ]
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: DeleteIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      CorsConfiguration:
        CorsRules:
          - AllowedHeaders:
              - '*'
            AllowedMethods:
              - GET
              - PUT
              - POST
              - DELETE
              - HEAD
            AllowedOrigins:
              - !Ref AllowedCORSOrigin
            ExposedHeaders:
              - ETag
              - x-amz-request-id
              - x-amz-meta-custom-header
            MaxAge: 3000
      NotificationConfiguration:
        CloudWatchConfigurations:
          - Event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
            CloudWatchConfiguration:
              LogGroupName: !Ref UploadsLogGroup
          - Event: s3:ObjectRemoved:*
            CloudWatchConfiguration:
              LogGroupName: !Ref UploadsLogGroup
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  UploadsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref UploadsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${UploadsBucket.Arn}'
              - !Sub '${UploadsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyIncorrectEncryptionHeader
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${UploadsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption': 'AES256'
          - Sid: RequireEncryption
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${UploadsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Null:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption': 'true'

  UploadsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/s3/uploads-${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 90

Outputs:
  UploadsBucketName:
    Description: Name of the created S3 bucket
    Value: !Ref UploadsBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UploadsBucketName'

  UploadsBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the created S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt UploadsBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UploadsBucketArn'

  UploadsBucketDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the created S3 bucket
    Value: !GetAtt UploadsBucket.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UploadsBucketDomainName'
